script: Finally, set your availability honestly. If you can work two hours a day, say so. If you need two days' notice, say that too. A clear profile reduces messages from people you cannot serve, and it builds trust with those you can. Start with one platform, not all of them. Complete your profile to one hundred percent. Then, in your first month, apply to about ten carefully chosen jobs. Quality beats quantity. A short, personal proposal that answers the client's exact question wins more often than a copy and paste message. In the next video, we find clients.
